g.text: Academic Performance Monitoring System with Analytics (APMS) • DepEd High School Relational Schema & Data Architecture
• Referential Actions: cascadeOnDelete (Profiles, Pivot) | restrictOnDelete (Grades, Calendar, Structure)
• Soft Deletions: Governed by status enum transitions ('active'/'inactive'/'draft'/'locked')
1. Atomic Fact Table: The grades table stores quarterly grades with a unique constraint on (student_enrollment_id, section_subject_id, quarter_id).
2. Role-Segregated Profiles: The users table handles authentication while teachers, students, and parents hold domain-specific profile records.
3. Reusable Catalogs vs Instance Offerings: sections is reusable; school_year_sections instantiates sections per academic year.
4. Honors Policy Engine: achievement_rules defines thresholds (DepEd Order 36, s. 2016) evaluating grades into achievements.
5. Non-Repudiation Audit: activity_logs captures all polymorphic modifications with old and new JSON payloads for accountability.
